messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — we need to lock what's going into the 2.1.1 mini release. Proposal: top priority = any crash/regression with >3 customers, then security, then P1 perf regressions, then 1–2 high-impact UX bugs. Non-blocking enhancements go to 2.2. Thoughts?
Samir Patel: +1 on prioritizing crashes. Can we use the 'customer-affect' tag in JIRA to quantify?
Alex Rivera: We have two regressions from canary: streaming drop rate spike and a tokenizer mismatch. Streaming spike affected 5 customers, tokenizer only internal. I'd push tokenizer to 2.2.
Jorge Velasquez: For perf regressions, what's our SLO breach criteria? >15% p99? Also, what's the rollback plan if a fix introduces flakiness?
Ellie (PM): SLO breach = p99 latency > 2x baseline for >30m. Rollback: A/B rollback via rollout service + fallback model variant. I'll document in release notes.
Maya Chen: Can we get quick numbers? Samir, can you grab customer counts and tag list?
Samir Patel: On it. Fetching now: querying /jira?jql=project=INF AND labels in (customer-affect)
Samir Patel: Results: 8 tickets flagged, 3 are regressions impacting >=3 customers, 2 perf, 3 UX polish.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release/2.1.1-canary → infra-stage at 11:02 UTC
Alex Rivera: Canary logs show streaming spike at 11:06 — attaching snippet:
```
[stream] drop_rate=0.12 -> baseline 0.03
[router] retry=4
```
Maya Chen: Ok isolate patch for streaming spike, we can ship that hotpatch. Tokenizer fix moved to 2.2.
Jorge Velasquez: Agree. Also recommend adding automated check to CI for tokenization regression.
Ellie (PM): I'll update the roadmap and create two release notes bullets. Also scheduling 30m rollback drill tomorrow 9am PT.
Samir Patel: created a quick filter: https://jira.company/browse/INF-quick-filter-2.1.1
Maya Chen: Great. Final decision: ship streaming spike fix as hotpatch in 2.1.1, hold tokenizer and non-urgent UX for 2.2. Owners: Alex (streaming), Ellie (notes), Jorge (CI test).
Samir Patel: noted. :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: Thanks team. I'll post final in the release channel once canary stabilizes.
